details:
Here are some QoL mods/features I was using on daily, that can make a big difference for a lot of users:

1. Flight (without no-clip) - sometimes we like to feel like we have FBT. Flight allows us to lay down without being stuck to the floor, this is helpful especially when you hang out with many FBT users. Less strain on your neck, and you can use it to check out the bigger/pretty worlds from a better distance.
2. Immobilizer - a mod that kept your legs in place when turning your head etc. Something that helped me with my body dissociating. This mod and flight was used by me every single day I was on VRC. No one likes when your legs move around as you turn your head to talk to your friend ;-;
3. CC mod - as someone who is hard-of-hearing on one ear, its difficult to keep up with a conversation if you have to keep asking 'can you repeat?'. There is also a big community of fully deaf folks who still want to communicate with/understand others better. Not many people are willing to use a pen or to learn ASL/BSL.

^ which brings me to another point- VRC 'text messages', a great way to actually contact your friends that are not in the same world. Instead of editing the invite req/reply, a way of texting your friend would be a good thing to add.

4. Avatar hider- a mod that would help with FPS. Having a feature that can hide friend's / strangers avatars when they are far away from you in a world. It helped me a lot with my FPS when using Quest w/ VD via SteamVR. It made my game a bit more optimized. 
5. Proper - particle limiter -where you can choose how much you want to limit.
6. Anti-crash against photon bots and event6/7/8 etc.- whether you like it or not, there will be people who will bypass EAC fast, adding a proper anti crash to the game would save many. 

On additional note- running VRC with EAC eats ~50% more memory than it used to. If there is any way to fix this and the lag spikes people have- that would be great.

Personally I am not gonna install the game until some of the QoL features are added. Plus my pc is not the beefiest, so having ~65% of my memory being used by purely running VRC alone- I am not interested. Especially since I need to run Virtual Desktop with it. Running it with opera and discord would simply kill my ram ;-;
title: Recommended QoL mods (+ some improvements)
